key_insight: AdamX uses cosine similarity to adaptively scale gradient updates, aiming for more stable and efficient first-order optimization.
engineering_relevance: The method is model-agnostic and easy to plug into existing training pipelines, making it useful for practical large-scale training.
method: Adjusts update magnitudes using cosine similarity between directions.
Adds a variance rectification scheme to smooth early-stage training.
Designed as a scalable Adam-style optimizer under a fixed hyperparameter budget.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive convergence rates across benchmark datasets and architectures, measured by epochs needed to reach predefined performance thresholds.
watch_item: Results are summarized at a high level in the abstract, so practical gains may depend on the choice of model, dataset, and threshold settings.
paper_title: AdamX: Cosine similarity meets gradient descent
